answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files a census entry for a terrace plot, signed after a voyage leg. Each epoch auditors re-walk 10% of plots against the knoll survey; a missing or copied entry burns the bond. First 42, k-th 42+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,039,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Rented census-takers fail: entries are key-bound; a second filing on one key burns both. An honest agent pays 42 once, keeps the bond.
